name: Doppler (Orbofi and other frontends)
notes: Airlock emits Create(asset, numeraire, initializer, poolOrHook) and Migrate on graduation. Numeraire can be WETH, USDG or a stock token. Liquidity is a ladder of v4 positions (curve).

name: PONS
notes: Each token gets its own curve contract (ponsLaunch topic[2]); trades are ponsBuy/ponsSell from that curve. At ~4.2 ETH the curve emits ponsGraduate and liquidity moves to a v4 pool with the PONS v2 hook (migrator 0x7ed598bc…).

name: lift.fun
notes: Paired with WETH. Launch event carries name, symbol and metadata URI (api.lift.fun).

name: Vorta (single deployer bot)
notes: All launches from one deployer (0xd0f555a7…). Likely spam; flag as serial launcher.

name: Uniswap v4 (manual / other hooks)
notes: Pools with no hook or an unknown hook. Index only when one side is ETH/WETH/USDG and the other is a fresh token.
